description: Expert Committee compiles and uploads signed joint inspection report, geotagged infrastructural photographs, laboratory equipment checklists, and video links.
aphClauseCitation: APH 2024-2027 Chapter I Cl. 1.10 & Chapter II Table 2.3

entryPrerequisites.description: Physical visit completed by appointed committee members.

allowedTransitions.buttonLabel: Submit Favourable EVC Report to Competent Authority
validationRules: Report must recommend approval with zero unrectified physical deficiencies
Minimum 2 committee members must digitally sign the report
Video recording link must be verified accessible
Geotagged photographs must have valid metadata coordinates

allowedTransitions.buttonLabel: Refer Adverse EVC Report to Standing Hearing Committee
validationRules: Adverse observations recorded (e.g., inadequate built-up area, missing lab equipment)
Itemized EVC Deficiency Statement attached for hearing bench

timePolicy.description: EVC Report Submission SLA: Committee must submit signed report within 24 hours of inspection.

exitConditions.description: Signed joint EVC report recorded in evc_reports table.
verificationCriteria: evc_report record exists with review_status in ['RECOMMENDED_APPROVAL', 'RECOMMENDED_DEFICIENCY']
